notes: The forwarder persona sits on gmail.com rather than a reserved example domain, because the Cloudflare Authentication-Results records the real forwarding account's domain and is not itself scrubbable. Rewriting From: to example.com left the verdict saying gmail.com and the header saying example.com, which no correct classifier can accept. Only the local-part is synthetic.
